subtitle: A pixel-and-ink sanctuary above the clouds
hint: Move with WASD / arrows · Click the ground · Press E near a building
mobileHint: Tap the ground or use the joystick at lower left
coming: The complete practice experience opens in the next stage. For now, enter, explore, and preview what is coming.

oracle.name: Oracle Hall
oracle.desc: Shake the bamboo cylinder and encounter one of the 64 hexagrams.

meditation.name: Meditation Hall
meditation.desc: Rest for a while between breath and drifting cloud.

taichi.name: Tai Chi Court
taichi.desc: Follow the master through six foundational forms.

library.name: Wisdom Library
library.desc: Discover daily wisdom and The I Ching Book of Answers.

garden.name: Practice Garden
garden.desc: Stretch, breathe, and complete a daily practice.

wish.name: Wish Pavilion
wish.desc: Leave one quiet wish with the mountain wind.

bamboo.name: Bamboo Grove
bamboo.desc: A hidden wisdom card may be waiting among the leaves.

gate.name: Entrance Gate
gate.desc: When the heart grows still, the path appears.

sanqing.name: Sanqing Hall
sanqing.desc: The principal hall, honoring Yuanshi, Lingbao, and Daode Tianzun—the Three Pure Ones.

wealth.name: God of Wealth Hall
wealth.desc: A side hall honoring Marshal Zhao Gongming and reflecting on effort, integrity, and wise stewardship.

hiddenText: Know contentment, and you will not be disgraced. Know when to stop, and you will avoid danger.
